headline: Kazakhstan Enacts Framework Linking Crypto Mining to State Reserves
summary: Kazakhstan implemented a new model of digital asset mining that connects grid electricity access for industrial miners with the accumulation of a national strategic crypto reserve, under regulations approved by the government.
why: Kazakhstan became one of the world's primary bitcoin mining destinations following China's mining ban, leading regulators to tighten energy quotas and taxation.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The state framework formalizes grid electricity allocation in exchange for building a sovereign digital asset reserve.
